name: nab
description: Ultra-fast web fetcher and MCP server written in Rust. Fetches any URL as clean Markdown with HTTP/3, JavaScript rendering, anti-fingerprinting, browser cookie authentication from Chrome/Firefox/Brave, and 1Password integration.
